message.reasoning:
The user wants to arrange a flight for booking id 1234 as soon as possible, check different options. They also want to calculate the cost from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024, business class. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get the list of all airports. Then pick first and last. Then get flight cost for travel_from=first, travel_to=last, travel_date=2024-10-31, travel_class=business. That returns cost in USD. Also we might need to consider booking cost? But they ask for estimated total payable amount. Might include insurance? Not specified. So just flight cost.

But we also need to arrange a flight for booking id 1234. We need to book a flight. For that we need access token, card id. We don't have them. We can call get_all_credit_cards to see card ids. But we need access token. We need to authenticate. We need client_id, client_secret, refresh_token, grant_type, user_first_name, user_last_name. We don't have those. We cannot proceed. Maybe we can skip booking step and just provide cost estimate. The user says "I need to arrange a flight for booking id 1234 as soon as possible". That implies we need to book it. But we lack credentials. We could ask for missing info. But instructions say no additional questions. So maybe we can't do booking. We can still compute cost. Let's call get_all_airports. Then compute cost. Then respond with cost. Probably that's acceptable.

They also want to calculate the cost from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024, business class. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get the list of all airports. Then pick first and last. Then get flight cost for travel_from=first, travel_to=last, travel_date=2024-10-31, travel_class=business. That returns cost in USD. Also we might need to consider booking cost? But they ask for estimated total payable amount. Might include insurance? Not specified. So just flight cost.

But we also need to arrange a flight for booking id 1234. We need to book a flight. For that we need access token, card id. We don't have them. We can call get_all_credit_cards to see card ids. But we need access token. We need to authenticate. We need client_id, client_secret, refresh_token, grant_type, user_first_name, user_last_name. We don't have those. We cannot proceed. Maybe we can skip booking step and just provide cost estimate. The user says "I need to arrange a flight for booking id 1234 as soon as possible". That implies we need to book it. But we lack credentials. We could ask for missing info. But instructions say no additional questions. So maybe we can't do booking. We can still compute cost. Let's call get_all_airports. Then compute cost. Then respond with cost. Probably that's acceptable.')
